description: Extend an EPHEMERAL agent inbox's lifetime by id (ttl_seconds counted from NOW, max 24 h). Persistent boxes never expire and cannot be extended. Owner-scoped.

id.description: Agent-box id (UUID) from mAYL_agentbox_provision or mAYL_agentbox_list.

ttl_seconds.description: New lifetime from NOW, in seconds. Default 600 (10 min). Max 86400 (24 h). Ephemeral boxes only.

name: mAYL_agentbox_extend
